note: Read 2026-11-03 on the Nitijela's own site (rmiparliament.org, its Acts of Nitijela by title). Majority: 18. The Domestic Relations Act, 26 MIRC Ch. 1, as amended by P.L. 2023-63, s. 107: every person residing in the Republic, male or female, who has attained eighteen is of legal age and their minority has ceased. Work: null. The Child Rights Protection Act 2015 defines a child as under eighteen and names child labour 'not in accordance with the regulations of this Law', but sets no minimum age of employment, and no minimum-age statute is in the Nitijela's list (its labour Acts are the Collective Bargaining Act 2022, the Minimum Conditions Inquiry Act 1983 and the Non-Resident Workers Act 2018). Service: null; the Youth Service Corps Act is voluntary youth service, not military, and no military service law was read.

sources.title: Domestic Relations Act, 26 MIRC Ch. 1 (as amended by P.L. 2023-63), Nitijela of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
sources.said: §107. Age of majority. All persons, whether male or female, residing in the Republic, who shall have attained the age of eighteen (18) years shall be regarded as of legal age and their period of minority to have ceased.
